title: Principled Voice local corpus manifest line
description: One JSON object per line in data/manifest.jsonl. Describes one recording. Fields marked null must be filled by the data provider or a human reviewer; the intake tooling must never infer speaker, language, transcript, emotion or license terms from audio.

clip_id.description: Stable local identifier; must not encode a real name.

file.description: Path relative to the data root. Absolute paths and '..' are rejected.

sha256.description: Canonical file hash computed by inventory; null before intake.

speaker_id.description: Pseudonymous group key. Must be stable across sessions of the same person.

session_id.description: Recording session/room/day group; prevents splitting one session across splits.

script_id.description: Prompt/text group; prevents the same script leaking across splits.

language.description: BCP-47-like tag as declared by the provider, e.g. zh-CN or en-US. No inference.

transcript_status.description: ASR drafts are not ground truth and do not clear a clip.

speaker_role.description: Who is speaking. Provided by the rights holder, not guessed from acoustics.

usage_status.description: Only 'cleared' may enter a training set, and only after both license and authorization references validate.

quality.description: Objective measurements and human review notes, filled after files arrive. No threshold is defined until the real distribution is inspected.

split.description: Assigned by the deterministic grouping planner, not by hand.
